description: Agent recommends cron over Celery but user has not decided; nothing built.

record.prompt: for sending the monthly reports, should we use Celery or just a cron job? don't change anything yet, I want to think about it
record.assistant: For one job per month, I'd lean towards a plain cron entry calling `python -m reports.job monthly`: no broker, no worker process, nothing to monitor beyond cron's mail. Celery (with beat) makes sense if we expect many scheduled or retried tasks, or need per-task visibility. A middle ground is APScheduler inside the app process. I haven't changed anything - let me know which way you want to go.
